2:275 ٱلَّذِينَ يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلرِّبَوٰا۟ لَا يَقُومُونَ إِلَّا كَمَا يَقُومُ ٱلَّذِى يَتَخَبَّطُهُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ مِنَ ٱلْمَسِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا ٱلْبَيْعُ مِثْلُ ٱلرِّبَوٰا۟ ۗ وَأَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْبَيْعَ وَحَرَّمَ ٱلرِّبَوٰا۟ ۚ فَمَن جَآءَهُۥ مَوْعِظَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ فَٱنتَهَىٰ فَلَهُۥ مَا سَلَفَ وَأَمْرُهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَمَنْ عَادَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ

law_name: Shariah Resolutions in Islamic Finance (2nd edition)
fatwa_id: Resolution No.11 (BNM, Shariah Resolutions in Islamic Finance, 2nd ed. 2010)
rule_subject: sukuk：Utilisation of third-party mudarabah asset for sukuk ijarah not allowed
content:
Utilisation of third-party mudarabah asset for sukuk ijarah not allowed.

Resolution
The SAC, in its 67 th meeting dated 3 May 2007, has resolved that the proposed issuance of sukuk ijarah that utilises a third party’s asset acquired through a mudarabah contract is not allowed. This is because the method used for determining the mudarabah profit that is based on cost saving derived from the issuance of sukuk ijarah is not consistent with the principles of mudarabah profit as recognised by the scholars. 16 SHARIAH RESOLUTIONS IN ISLAMIC FINANCE

Source: BNM, Shariah Resolutions in Islamic Finance, 2nd ed. (October 2010), Resolution 11 (local verification PDF page index 34; MD5 08e35a8c9aa2faafc5285d8d9d794484). Official English URL: https://www.bnm.gov.my/documents/20124/9198675/shariah_resolutions_2nd_edition_EN.pdf. SAC page: https://www.bnm.gov.my/committees/sac.

fatwa_id: Resolution No.62 (BNM, Shariah Resolutions in Islamic Finance, 2nd ed. 2010)
rule_subject: sukuk：Sukuk ijarah / Shariah shares as tawarruq underlying asset permissible
content:
Sukuk ijarah / Shariah shares as tawarruq underlying asset permissible.

Resolution
The SAC, in its 58 th meeting dated 27 April 2006, has resolved that the application of sukuk ijarah and Shariah compliant shares as the underlying asset in tawarruq or commodity murabahah transaction to manage liquidity in Islamic financial system is permissible. The sukuk ijarah shall be backed by tangible asset or a combination of tangible asset and financial asset.

Source: BNM, Shariah Resolutions in Islamic Finance, 2nd ed. (October 2010), Resolution 62 (local verification PDF page index 116; MD5 08e35a8c9aa2faafc5285d8d9d794484). rule_subject: sukuk：Sukuk commodity murabahah via tawarruq with ≥3 parties permissible
content:
Sukuk commodity murabahah via tawarruq with ≥3 parties permissible.

Resolution
The SAC, in its 67 th meeting dated 3 May 2007, has resolved that there is no objection in Shariah for the issuance of sukuk commodity murabahah based on tawarruq as long as the sale transactions involve three or more contracting parties.

rule_subject: sukuk：Sukuk BBA underlying mudarabah investment need not exist throughout tenure
content:
Sukuk BBA underlying mudarabah investment need not exist throughout tenure.

Resolution
The SAC, in its 41 st meeting dated 8 March 2004, has resolved that the underlying asset which is the Mudarabah Interbank Investment may not necessarily exist throughout the Sukuk BBA maturity tenure.

2:275 ٱلَّذِينَ يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلرِّبَوٰا۟ لَا يَقُومُونَ إِلَّا كَمَا يَقُومُ ٱلَّذِى يَتَخَبَّطُهُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ مِنَ ٱلْمَسِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا ٱلْبَيْعُ مِثْلُ ٱلرِّبَوٰا۟ ۗ وَأَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْبَيْعَ وَحَرَّمَ ٱلرِّبَوٰا۟ ۚ فَمَن جَآءَهُۥ مَوْعِظَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ فَٱنتَهَىٰ فَلَهُۥ مَا سَلَفَ وَأَمْرُهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَمَنْ عَادَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ

4:29 يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَأْكُلُوٓا۟ أَمْوَٰلَكُم بَيْنَكُم بِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ إِلَّآ أَن تَكُونَ تِجَـٰرَةً عَن تَرَاضٍ مِّنكُمْ ۚ وَلَا تَقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِكُمْ رَحِيمًا

law_name: Shariah Resolutions in Islamic Finance (2nd edition)
fatwa_id: Resolution No.105 (BNM, Shariah Resolutions in Islamic Finance, 2nd ed. 2010)
rule_subject: sukuk：Danajamin guarantee: sale-based capital+profit; partnership capital only
content:
Danajamin guarantee: sale-based capital+profit; partnership capital only.

Resolution
The SAC, in its 10th special meeting dated 9 April 2009, has resolved that: i. For sale-based sukuk like murabahah, Danajamin shall guarantee both capital and profit value; and ii. For sukuk issued based on isytirak contract (partnership) like musyarakah, mudarabah and wakalah bi al-istithmar, Danajamin shall guarantee the capital value only.

Source: BNM, Shariah Resolutions in Islamic Finance, 2nd ed. (October 2010), Resolution 105 (local verification PDF page index 189; MD5 08e35a8c9aa2faafc5285d8d9d794484). Official English URL: https://www.bnm.gov.my/documents/20124/9198675/shariah_resolutions_2nd_edition_EN.pdf. SAC page: https://www.bnm.gov.my/committees/sac.

law_name: Shariah Resolutions in Islamic Finance (2nd edition)
fatwa_id: Resolution No.108 (BNM, Shariah Resolutions in Islamic Finance, 2nd ed. 2010)
rule_subject: sukuk：Ownership of sukuk ijarah underlying asset follows contract / Danajamin pay-out
content:
Ownership of sukuk ijarah underlying asset follows contract / Danajamin pay-out.

Resolution
The SAC, in its 10th special meeting dated 9 April 2009, has resolved that: i. The ownership status of the underlying asset in sukuk ijarah is subject to the terms and conditions of the contract. If Danajamin only pays the periodic rental amount or coupon within the sukuk tenure, the underlying asset remains under the investors’ ownership. However, if Danajamin pays the purchase undertaking price, the ownership of the underlying asset will be transferred to the sukuk issuer. Notwithstanding that, the asset will be regarded as a security or a collateral for the debt which has been paid by Danajamin to the investors, until the sukuk issuer repays the amount paid; and ii. The guarantee on sukuk issued based on ijarah contract may cover guarantee on the rent as well as wa`d to purchase the asset.

Source: BNM, Shariah Resolutions in Islamic Finance, 2nd ed. (October 2010), Resolution 108 (local verification PDF page index 192; MD5 08e35a8c9aa2faafc5285d8d9d794484).
